name: @tuucho/plugin-tuucho-contact
description: Guest contact form, signed-in account chat, and the admin Contact hub. Disable to hide /contact and the inbox.

identityMax.label: Identity max length
identityMax.description: Maximum characters for the guest name/email line on the public contact form.
identityMax.sectionDescription: Size caps for the public form, signed-in chat, and attached images.

messageMax.label: Message max length
messageMax.description: Maximum characters for a contact or chat message body.

imageMaxBytes.label: Contact image max size
imageMaxBytes.description: Largest image a guest may attach on /contact (for example 5m). Raise only if you accept bigger files.

chatImageMaxBytes.label: Chat image max size
chatImageMaxBytes.description: Largest image in a signed-in chat (for example 5m).

maxSessionsPerUser.label: Max chat sessions per user
maxSessionsPerUser.description: How many open chat threads one account may keep. Older threads stay readable.

mediaContactDir.label: Contact media directory
mediaContactDir.description: Public path under the media host for guest contact images. Change only if you relocated that folder.
mediaContactDir.sectionDescription: Where uploaded contact and chat images are stored on disk.

mediaChatDir.label: Chat media directory
mediaChatDir.description: Public path under the media host for signed-in chat images.

smtpHost.label: Chat SMTP host
smtpHost.description: SMTP host that receives inbound chat mail (cPanel pipe). Leave empty if you only use the web inbox.
smtpHost.sectionDescription: Mailbox that turns inbound email into chat. Kernel no-reply SMTP stays in kernel JSON.

smtpPort.label: Chat SMTP port
smtpPort.description: SMTP port for that mailbox (usually 465 or 587). Leave empty if host is empty.

smtpUser.label: Chat SMTP user
smtpUser.description: SMTP username for the chat mailbox. Often the same as From email.

smtpPassword.label: Chat SMTP password
smtpPassword.description: Password for the chat mailbox. Never shown after save. Type a new value only to replace it.

fromEmail.label: Chat From email
fromEmail.description: From address on shop replies that go out through chat SMTP.

seedRecipient.label: Seed recipient (empty table only)
seedRecipient.description: First inbound contact recipient used only when the recipient table is empty. After that, manage recipients in the extra below.
seedRecipient.sectionDescription: Bootstrap addresses and how hard guests may hit the form. Live staff copies are the spy extra below this form.

forwardRecipient.label: cPanel pipe forward recipient
forwardRecipient.description: Address cPanel forwards inbound mail to, if you use a pipe. Leave empty without that setup.

adminOwnerEmailSuppressionTimeout.label: Admin owner-email mute max
adminOwnerEmailSuppressionTimeout.description: Longest mute for owner-email copies from admin (for example 10m).

rateContactEmail.label: Contact email rate limit
rateContactEmail.description: Window:max for guest contact mail (for example 15m:5). Protects the inbox from floods.

disableRateContactEmail.label: Disable contact email rate limit
disableRateContactEmail.description: Turn on only on a local shop while testing. Leave off in production.

devEmailChatDir.label: Dev chat email dump dir
devEmailChatDir.description: Folder where chat mail is written in development instead of SMTP. Ignore on a live host.
